text: 在爱尔兰经济数据被大幅上修后，欧元区第二季度经济增速高于最初估计。欧盟统计局周一表示，欧元区GDP增长0.6%，高于此前公布的0.4%初值。这是逾一年来最快的季度增速，此前这个由21个国家组成的货币联盟在2026年第一季度经济增长停滞。此次修正主要由爱尔兰推动。爱尔兰上周表示，4月至6月经济产出增长10.2%，远高于此前3.9%的估值，主要得益于包括苹果和礼来在内的跨国企业表现强劲。相比之下，法国、奥地利和葡萄牙的经济表现均弱于最初估计。
text_en: The eurozone economy grew faster in the second quarter than initially estimated, after Irish economic data was sharply revised upward. Eurostat said Monday that eurozone GDP grew 0.6%, above the preliminary reading of 0.4%—the fastest quarterly pace in over a year, following stagnant growth in the 21-country currency bloc in the first quarter of 2026. The revision was driven mainly by Ireland, which said last week that economic output grew 10.2% in April-June, far above the previous estimate of 3.9%, boosted by strong performance from multinational companies including Apple and Eli Lilly. By contrast, France, Austria and Portugal all performed weaker than initially estimated.
